responsibility: Declares the analyzer’s store subsystem for mapping abstract regions to symbolic values. It describes the cluster-based memory model, uncertainty bookkeeping for maybe-live values, binding-key and bit-range abstractions for concrete and symbolic subregions, binding_cluster contents and escape/touch flags, the store API for update/merge/purge/unknown-call handling and summary replay, and store_manager as the uniquing owner for concrete and symbolic binding keys.
same_name_distinction: Defines the store subsystem’s types and interfaces—binding keys, bit-range abstractions, binding clusters, store, and store_manager—whereas store.cc provides the concrete algorithms for binding updates, clobbering, merging, alias handling, and related selftests.
